[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]XPrompt target mode for the prompt input stack[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Editing an existing xprompt definition from the ACE TUI is a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]first-class, obvious, reliable loop: loading a definition from any [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]surface puts the prompt input widget stack into a visibly distinct [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]"targeting" state, <enter> offers a single-keypress "save to the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]targeted xprompt" option, and saving writes the correct file [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim](chezmoi source included) and then offers exactly the follow-up [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]actions that file needs — commit/push, a scoped chezmoi apply, or [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]the matching `sase memory init` / `sase skill init`.[/#D7D7AF]
